mintAuthority.summary: USDz has one reviewed native-issuance deployment: immutable Ethereum bytecode with SPCT-gated deposit minting under a 2-of-6 admin Safe. Base, Arbitrum, Blast, and Manta are representations of the Ethereum liability connected by LayerZero/rollup burn-and-mint machinery; their adapters, minters, peers, and administrators are reviewed separately in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Anzen DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe (upgrade/role authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203, owner() on USDz token returned 0xc88729a8…; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN, 0xc88729a8…) = true; getOwners() returned 6 addresses; getThreshold() = 2; masterCopy slot0 = 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552 (Safe v1.3); guard storage slot = 0x0; getModulesPaginated returned empty array (count 0).

controls.label: SPCT deposit mint (user-callable, SPCT-gated)
controls.capDescription: deposit() and depositBySPCT() are callable by approved, permissioned SPCT holders; mint supply is bounded by SPCT availability and the issuer-controlled collateral/oracle path.
controls.evidence: The verified Ethereum USDz source exposes deposit(uint256) and depositBySPCT(uint256), which call internal _mintUSDz and increment totalPooledSPCT. The constructor binds the SPCT pool and price oracle; no privileged arbitrary mint function or proxy upgrade path was evidenced.

review.evidence: Canonicality verification at Ethereum block 25771000 on 2026-08-17 identifies Ethereum as the only independently issued USDz liability source. The verified non-proxy USDz source exposes SPCT-backed deposit() and depositBySPCT() paths that call _mintUSDz and increment totalPooledSPCT; its constructor binds the SPCT pool and price oracle. owner() is the Anzen 2-of-6 Safe, endpoint() is LayerZero V2, and no privileged arbitrary mint or native upgrade path was evidenced. Base, Arbitrum, Blast, and Manta are bridge representations whose adapter/minter, peer, pause, and owner controls are retained in bridgeRouteRisk rather than global Mint Authority. No independent prudential supervisor for the SPCT disclosure was evidenced.
review.reviewer: Codex USDz canonical mint-authority boundary verification
